address.line: 22 Dr Martin Luther King Jr Drive
address.lineWithUnit: 22 Dr Martin Luther King Jr Drive Unit C10

remarks: This townhouse is a gem, with its convenient location and desirable features. The proximity to the SONO COLLECTION, shops, restaurants, and the Aquarium, along with easy access to the Metro North train station, makes it an ideal spot for those seeking both convenience and entertainment options.  The fact that it's an end unit, offering enhanced privacy and additional windows for natural light, is definitely a plus. The three decks provide ample outdoor space, perfect for relaxing or entertaining guests. The hardwood flooring in the living room and dining room adds an elegant touch, and the modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances and granite countertops is sure to appeal to many.  Having two well-sized bedrooms with wall-to-wall carpeting and the main bedroom featuring sliders to a private deck sounds like a great setup for comfortable living. Plus, in-unit laundry adds to the convenience factor.  Parking is always a consideration, so having one assigned spot and an additional unassigned spot available is a nice perk. And the courtyard in the townhouse complex sounds like a charming feature.  Overall, this townhouse offers a blend of convenience, comfort, and style, making it a great option for anyone looking for a new home.  Photos are from the unit before current tenant.  Excellent references and credit score required.
